_comment: E11.7-11: the partner asset kit's downloadable files and video links (P10). Ships with both lists empty (founder decision 2, 2026-11-24); an empty list renders nothing. To add one, commit the file under public/partners/kit/, list it here as { "path": "partners/kit/<name>.<png|jpg|jpeg|webp|pdf>", "title": "...", "sharingRight": "..." } and record its sharing right in docs/prerequisites/founder-prerequisites.md (P10). A video is { "title": "...", "url": "https://..." }, shown as a plain link. The build fails on a listed file that is missing, of another type or without a sharing right, and on any file in the folder this list does not name.
